scope: Independent analysis of the five exact operator-provided Kit 2 native 720p60 YUYV/FFV1 video and 48 kHz stereo captures. No hardware access by this analyst.
limitations: Initial 2 or 3 black frames and one 50 ms interval at the acquisition boundary are retained observations; all subsequent intervals are 16/17 ms. Four settled capture-conversion variants differ by at most 1 RGB LSB. ASUS audio filters and rescales PCM. These observations establish the listed stable capture behaviors, not direct electrical HS/VS measurement, bit-exact FPGA PCM, retail compatibility, or factory-image acceptance.
